findings.title: Diagnostic generation can throw instead of reporting illegal HTML
findings.description:
The common-prefix and common-suffix scans run independently, so their ranges can overlap. For example, sanitizing `

` to `

` leaves matching characters at both ends that overlap in the shorter string. The subsequent `substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` then throws `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException`, aborting verification rather than collecting the validation error. Bound the suffix scan by the characters remaining after the prefix, and add a regression test for prohibited markup nested inside allowed markup.

findings.title: Choice-format normalization hides prohibited HTML
findings.description:
Replacing an entire choice expression with `...` exempts all its alternatives from HTML validation. For example, a translation of `error-invalid-multivalued-size` containing `{2,choice,0#<script>alert(1)</script>|1#value}` loses the script before the sanitizer sees it and can pass verification.

Protect only the choice-format syntax that conflicts with HTML parsing, or parse the expression and validate every alternative. Add a test demonstrating that prohibited tags inside choice branches are rejected.

findings.title: Lithuanian OTP instructions were replaced with Italian
findings.description: The new `totpStep1` value, `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, is Italian rather than Lithuanian. The same replacement appears in `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71`. Lithuanian users will now encounter foreign-language instructions during authenticator setup. Replace both values with Lithuanian translations while retaining the intended removal of links.
